description.en: Fully restores one player's TP (Technique Points): it is set to the player's maximum. GP is not changed.
Player handle, as returned by CMND_GET_PARTY_HANDLE or CMND_ADD_PARTY.

true once restored.
null if the script system is not ready, no argument is given, the player data is not available or the handle is not a valid player.

examples.case: Restoring one player (not found in script_clean/; invented)
